market_question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
reasoning: Winning the Stanley Cup is extremely difficult, and even top contenders typically have preseason probabilities under 15%. The market's implied 37.5% is far too high, overvaluing the Hurricanes by a massive margin. The true chance is closer to 12.5%, making No the clear value side.
evidence_points: Historical preseason Cup odds for any single team rarely exceed 15-20%.
Carolina Hurricanes have not won a Cup in the modern era and lack an all-time elite game-breaker.
NHL playoffs are high-variance; even the best regular season team often fails to win the Cup.
